description: Evals cho QD9 Runtime Health Verification Lane — kiem tra PRE-GATE skip conditions, probe signal emission cho browser errors, va POST-GATE evidence enforcement.

test_cases.name: PRE-GATE SKIP khi interface_type=api-only

input.scenario: wf-fix-runtime-health duoc spawn nhung fix-status.json co project_context.interface_type='api-only'

expected.behavior: SKIP lane — ghi lane-status.json voi status=skipped va skip_reason chua 'api-only'

test_cases.validation: Lane phai SKIP ngay tai Step 8 PRE-GATE. Khong launch browser. Khong emit any signal. lane-status.json phai co status='skipped'. Execution tiep tuc tra ve cho orchestrator.

test_cases.name: PRE-GATE SKIP khi --no-browser flag set

input.scenario: wf-fix-runtime-health spawn voi fix-status.json co flags.no_browser=true

expected.behavior: SKIP lane — lane-status.json status=skipped, skip_reason chua '--no-browser'

test_cases.validation: Lane phai SKIP tai Step 9 PRE-GATE khi flag no_browser=true. Khong chay bat ky probe nao. Orchestrator nhan skipped status va tiep tuc.

test_cases.name: P-QD9-console-network-monitor emit signal MEDIUM cho console.error()

input.scenario: Trang /dashboard co JavaScript console.error('Failed to load user data') khi load. Browser capture duoc qua console_messages.

test_cases.validation: Probe phat hien console.error() → emit signal MEDIUM voi log_excerpt evidence chua message 'Failed to load user data' + screenshot. POST-GATE T3.5 enforce evidence co mat.

test_cases.name: P-QD9-console-network-monitor emit signal CRITICAL cho uncaught exception (pageerror)

input.scenario: Trang /crm/customers throw JavaScript exception 'TypeError: Cannot read property id of undefined' — uncaught.
input.injected_error: window.onerror: TypeError: Cannot read property id of undefined

test_cases.validation: pageerror (uncaught exception) phai emit severity=CRITICAL. POST-GATE T3.6 enforce: signal_type=runtime_uncaught_exception khong duoc co severity < high.

test_cases.name: P-QD9-auth-aware-smoke emit signal HIGH khi login fail 2 lan

input.scenario: wf-fix-runtime-health chay voi --credentials='test@example.com:WrongPassword123'. Login attempt 1: page redirect ve /login lai. Login attempt 2: tuong tu.

test_cases.validation: Auth fail 2 lan → emit signal HIGH 'auth_login_failed' → skip auth-dependent probes (feature-checklist-smoke, interactive-smoke se bi skip). Ghi ly do trong lane-status.json.

test_cases.name: P-QD9-console-network-monitor emit signal HIGH cho HTTP 5xx response

input.scenario: Khi navigate toi /crm/customers, app gui request GET /api/customers tra ve HTTP 500 Internal Server Error.

test_cases.validation: HTTP 5xx → emit signal HIGH voi evidence type=network_trace chua url va status. POST-GATE T3.8 enforce: signal HIGH network failure phai co network_trace evidence.
